events.title: Why there's now a Germany-specific build
events.summary: A few weeks back we wrote about the review process Checkpoint '38 went through in Germany, where games depicting Nazi symbolism go through a separate review body. Here's where that landed.We built a Germany-specific version, released alongside the global one rather than replacing it. The change is narrow and specific: swastikas and party emblems are swapped for a neutral mark. events.title: We're part of Steam Next Fest, October 2026!
events.summary: Checkpoint '38 got selected for Steam Next Fest, October 2026. The demo is already live now, and it'll stay up through the event, so you don't have to wait for October to try it.Quick reminder for anyone landing here fresh: Checkpoint '38 is a document checking simulation in the Papers, Please lane. You inspect passports, visas, and permits at the Konstanz–Switzerland border, and the rulebook only gets stricter as you go.
